hawkDoveCompass.rationale_en: The FOMC unanimously raised the target to 3.75–4.00% on September 16 to address elevated inflation.
hawkDoveCompass.rationale_zh: FOMC于9月16日一致加息至3.75%–4.00%，以应对偏高通胀。
hawkDoveCompass.method_en: Qualitative editorial context, not a market probability. Current policy is verified from the September statement.
hawkDoveCompass.method_zh: 编辑定性背景，不是市场概率。当前政策依据9月声明核实。

pillarSummary.en: September’s unanimous hike lifted the policy range to 3.75–4.00%. Follow the cost of capital, public funding and AI’s changing effects on productivity and prices.
pillarSummary.zh: 9月一致加息使政策利率升至3.75%–4.00%。持续追踪资本成本、公共资金，以及AI对生产率与价格的变化影响。

pillars.read_en: BEA reported June headline PCE down 0.1% month over month but still up 3.7% year over year; core PCE rose 0.1% monthly and 3.3% yearly. Real consumption grew 0.4%, while the saving rate fell to 2.7%. Disinflation resumed, but the level and household buffer still constrain policy.
pillars.read_zh: 美国经济分析局公布：6月整体PCE环比下降0.1%，同比仍上涨3.7%；核心PCE环比上涨0.1%、同比上涨3.3%。实际消费增长0.4%，储蓄率降至2.7%。通胀重新降温，但其绝对水平与家庭缓冲仍约束政策。

pillars.read_en: September’s unanimous hike lifted the policy range to 3.75–4.00%. Follow the cost of capital, public funding and AI’s changing effects on productivity and prices.
pillars.read_zh: 9月一致加息使政策利率升至3.75%–4.00%。持续追踪资本成本、公共资金，以及AI对生产率与价格的变化影响。

pillars.read_en: July nonfarm payrolls fell 23,000 versus an 87,000 consensus. May and June were revised down 103,000 combined; the three-month net gain is only 60,000. Unemployment fell to 4.1% as participation slipped to 61.4%, while hourly earnings growth slowed to 3.2% year over year.
pillars.read_zh: 7月非农减少2.3万人，而市场共识为增加8.7万人。5月与6月合计下修10.3万人，三个月净增仅6万人。失业率降至4.1%的同时，劳动参与率降至61.4%；时薪同比增速放缓至3.2%。

pillars.read_en: Official priorities now span full-stack AI exports, domestic chips and equipment, energy and grid capacity, polysilicon and solar inputs, resilient industrial and defense supply chains, and housing supply. Incentives and protection can improve domestic demand visibility, while tariffs, minimum import prices, financing and local execution can raise costs.
pillars.read_zh: 正式优先方向现覆盖全栈AI出口、本土芯片与设备、能源与电网产能、多晶硅与太阳能投入品、产业及国防供应链韧性和住房供给。激励与保护可提高本土需求能见度，关税、最低进口价、融资与地方执行也可能抬高成本。

pillars.name_zh: 特朗普、贸易与联储影响力
pillars.read_en: Trump shaped Fed leadership through nomination and can influence expectations publicly, but cannot cast the other FOMC votes or decree either the policy rate or long Treasury yields. His stronger direct channel is industrial policy: tariffs, exemptions, minimum import prices, export support, procurement and permitting redistribute demand and costs toward selected US capacity.
pillars.read_zh: 特朗普可通过提名塑造联储领导层，也能以公开表态影响预期，但不能代替其他FOMC票委投票，更不能以命令设定政策利率或长期美债收益率。他更强的直接渠道是产业政策：关税、豁免、最低进口价、出口支持、采购与许可会把需求和成本重新导向特定美国本土产能。

name.en: Minutes of the July 28-29 FOMC Meeting
name.zh: 7 月 28 至 29 日 FOMC 会议纪要

before.en: The policy statement had already documented a 9-3 hold at 3.50-3.75%, with three members preferring a quarter-point increase. The minutes were the scheduled detailed official record.
before.zh: 政策声明此前已记录委员会以 9 比 3 将利率维持在 3.50% 至 3.75%，三名委员倾向加息 25 个基点；会议纪要是按计划发布的详细官方记录。

print.en: The Federal Reserve published the July 28-29 meeting minutes at 2:00 p.m. EDT on August 19, 2026.
print.zh: 美联储于 2026 年 8 月 19 日美东时间下午 2 时发布 7 月 28 至 29 日会议纪要。

marketWindow.en: Official-document update only. No independently verified closing-price window is attached to this refresh, so no single-cause market attribution is made.
marketWindow.zh: 本次仅更新官方文件。由于未附加经过独立核实的收盘价格窗口，因此不作单一因果市场归因。

repricing.en: The document adds detail to an already known divided hold; without a separately cited rate-market window, this archive does not assert a new probability or yield move.
repricing.zh: 该文件为已知的分歧性维持决定补充细节；在缺少单独引用的利率市场窗口时，本档案不声称新的概率或收益率变化。

equityReaction.en: No equity return is asserted for this event because the refresh did not verify an attributable market-close source.
equityReaction.zh: 本次刷新未核实可归因的市场收盘来源，因此不声称该事件对应的股票收益。

industryTransmission.en: A divided hold keeps both discount-rate and inflation-risk channels relevant for AI infrastructure, cloud, semiconductor and power investment, but the minutes alone do not select a trade direction.
industryTransmission.zh: 存在分歧的维持决定意味着贴现率与通胀风险渠道仍会影响 AI 基础设施、云、半导体与电力投资，但会议纪要本身不足以选择交易方向。

verdict.en: Fresh official policy evidence; balanced interpretation and no market forecast. Not investment advice.
verdict.zh: 新的官方政策证据；保持均衡解读，不作市场预测。非投资建议。

name.zh: 操作台取消本期新增储备管理购买

before.en: The prior 14 July–13 August window combined about $17.6bn of reinvestment purchases with an additional $10bn of reserve-management purchases.
before.zh: 此前7月14日至8月13日窗口包含约176亿美元再投资购买，以及额外100亿美元储备管理购买。

print.en: For 14 August–14 September, the Desk plans about $17.0bn of reinvestment purchases and no reserve-management purchases.
print.zh: 8月14日至9月14日，操作台计划约170亿美元再投资购买，不进行储备管理购买。

marketWindow.en: Operational schedule, not a clean trading event. Treasury yields also reflect inflation, growth, issuance, term premium and global risk, so no single market move is assigned to the schedule.
marketWindow.zh: 这是操作计划，不是干净的交易事件。美债收益率还受通胀、增长、发行、期限溢价与全球风险影响，因此不把单一市场波动归因于该计划。

repricing.en: The step-down indicates the Desk currently sees less need for incremental RMPs. It does not target the 10-year or 30-year yield and is not evidence of QE or an emergency rescue.
repricing.zh: 操作降档说明操作台当前认为新增储备管理购买需求较低。它不针对10年或30年期收益率，也不是QE或紧急救市的证据。

equityReaction.en: No causal equity move is claimed. The relevant monitoring channel is whether money-market conditions remain orderly while long-end yields continue to clear in the market.
equityReaction.zh: 不主张存在可归因的股市波动。应监测的渠道是货币市场能否保持有序，以及长端收益率是否继续由市场出清。

industryTransmission.en: With no long-end yield cap, capital-intensive AI, power, industrial and housing projects remain exposed to 10-year and 30-year financing conditions.
industryTransmission.zh: 由于不存在长端收益率上限，资本密集型AI、电力、工业与住房项目仍暴露于10年和30年期融资条件。

verdict.en: Routine ample-reserve implementation; active RMPs downshift to zero for the current window. Not investment advice.
verdict.zh: 这是充足准备金框架下的常规执行；当前窗口新增RMP降至零。非投资建议。

before.en: Economists expected payrolls to rise 87,000. Before the release, traders viewed a September hike as slightly more likely than not, while the soft-landing case still required positive job growth and stable participation.
before.zh: 经济学家预期非农增加8.7万人。数据发布前，交易员认为9月加息概率略高于不加息；软着陆叙事仍要求就业保持正增长并维持稳定参与率。

print.en: Payrolls fell 23,000; May and June were revised down 103,000 combined. Private payrolls still rose 30,000, but local-government education fell 50,000, retail 19,000 and financial activities 14,000; health care added 22,000. Unemployment was 4.1%, participation 61.4%, hourly earnings growth 3.2% year over year, and temporary layoffs rose 153,000 to 921,000.
print.zh: 非农减少2.3万人；5月与6月合计下修10.3万人。私人部门仍增加3万人，但地方政府教育减少5万人、零售减少1.9万人、金融活动减少1.4万人，医疗保健增加2.2万人。失业率为4.1%，劳动参与率61.4%，时薪同比增长3.2%，临时失业人数增加15.3万至92.1万。

marketWindow.en: Observation window: 8:30 ET release through early US trading; it is provisional, not a closing return. Oil and an ongoing AI valuation correction remained parallel market drivers.
marketWindow.zh: 观察窗口：美东8:30发布至美股早盘；这是盘中暂定读数，不是收盘收益。油价与仍在进行的AI估值调整也是并行驱动因素。

repricing.en: The 10-year Treasury yield fell from 4.67% immediately before the release to 4.60%. CME pricing cited by Axios cut the September hike probability to 44%, reversing a slightly-better-than-even pre-release chance; this is less-hawkish repricing, not evidence of an automatic cut.
repricing.zh: 10年期美债收益率从发布前的4.67%降至4.60%。Axios引用的CME定价把9月加息概率降至44%，逆转此前略高于五成的概率；这是偏鸽重定价，而非“自动降息”的证据。

equityReaction.en: In early trading, the S&P 500 rose 0.4%, the Nasdaq 1.1% and the Dow slipped 0.1%; S&P futures had gained 0.5%. The initial move treated weaker jobs as rate relief, but the window is not yet a final session verdict.
equityReaction.zh: 美股早盘标普500上涨0.4%、纳指上涨1.1%、道指下跌0.1%；此前标普期货上涨0.5%。初始交易把就业走弱视为利率缓解，但该窗口尚不是最终收盘裁决。

industryTransmission.en: Rate relief helps profitable AI leaders with long-duration cash flows. The sector details are less benign: retail and finance job losses point to demand and credit caution, while health care remained the only clear large-sector cushion. Quality dispersion is stronger than blanket risk-on.
industryTransmission.zh: 利率缓解有利于拥有长期现金流的盈利型AI龙头；行业明细却并不完全乐观：零售与金融就业下降提示需求和信贷谨慎，医疗保健是唯一清晰的大行业缓冲。质量分化强于全面risk-on。

verdict.en: Dovish labor shock, but not a clean soft landing: the falling unemployment rate was accompanied by labor-force exit. Not investment advice.
verdict.zh: 这是鸽派就业冲击，却不是干净的软着陆：失业率下降伴随着劳动力退出。非投资建议。

before.en: The administration described US dependence on imported polysilicon, ingots, wafers and cells as a semiconductor, solar and national-security vulnerability.
before.zh: 政府把美国对进口多晶硅、硅锭、硅片与电池片的依赖界定为半导体、太阳能与国家安全脆弱点。

print.en: The proclamation establishes minimum import prices and, from 4 December 2026, a 15% duty on covered derivatives, while authorizing incentives for US production of polysilicon, ingots, wafers and cells.
print.zh: 公告设立最低进口价，并从2026年12月4日起对相关衍生品征收15%关税，同时授权激励美国生产多晶硅、硅锭、硅片与电池片。

marketWindow.en: Policy action with delayed implementation, not a clean one-session market event. No standalone equity or rate move is assigned.
marketWindow.zh: 这是延后实施的政策行动，而非单一交易日事件；不指定独立股价或利率波动。

repricing.en: The policy protects domestic upstream economics and encourages onshoring, but raises the input-cost floor for uncovered downstream buyers.
repricing.zh: 该政策保护本土上游经济性并鼓励回流生产，但会抬高未获豁免下游买家的投入成本底线。

equityReaction.en: No causal index move is claimed. Company outcomes depend on product coverage, domestic capacity, trade-partner arrangements and the ability to pass through higher costs.
equityReaction.zh: 不主张存在可归因的指数波动。公司结果取决于产品适用范围、本土产能、贸易伙伴安排与成本转嫁能力。

industryTransmission.en: Domestic polysilicon and wafer capacity receive direct policy support across semiconductor and solar supply chains; module makers, developers and power users face cost, timing and capacity-ramp tradeoffs.
industryTransmission.zh: 本土多晶硅与硅片产能在半导体和太阳能供应链同时获得直接政策支持；组件制造商、开发商与电力用户则面临成本、时间与产能爬坡权衡。

verdict.en: Direct onshoring support with explicit downstream cost risk. Not investment advice.
verdict.zh: 这是直接本土化支持，也包含明确的下游成本风险。非投资建议。

marketSources.label_zh: 白宫经济顾问委员会：2026产业优先方向

before.zh: 注明日期的一手资料记录。

print.en: Treasury announced $125bn in 3-, 10- and 30-year securities, raising approximately $28.7bn in new cash after refinancing maturities.
print.zh: 财政部公布1250亿美元的3年、10年和30年期国债发行，用于到期再融资后，新增融资约287亿美元。

industryTransmission.en: Treasury supply and investor demand affect long-term financing conditions for data centers. Debt issuance is separate from the Fed’s policy-rate decision.
industryTransmission.zh: 国债供给和投资者需求影响数据中心长期融资环境。国债发行与联储政策利率决定属于不同机制。

verdict.en: Track implementation and subsequent official evidence.
verdict.zh: 跟踪执行情况和后续官方证据。

before.en: The release arrived one day after the hawkish FOMC hold. Markets needed to know whether May's 4.1% headline and 3.4% core inflation burst was reversing without consumption collapsing.
before.zh: 该报告在鹰派FOMC维持决定次日公布。市场需要判断5月整体4.1%、核心3.4%的通胀冲高是否逆转，同时消费是否避免坍塌。

print.en: Headline PCE fell 0.1% monthly and rose 3.7% yearly; core rose 0.1% monthly and 3.3% yearly. Real PCE grew 0.4%, nominal PCE 0.3%, and the saving rate fell to 2.7%. Services supplied $58.2bn of the $65.2bn nominal spending increase.
print.zh: 整体PCE环比下降0.1%、同比上涨3.7%；核心PCE环比上涨0.1%、同比上涨3.3%。实际PCE增长0.4%、名义PCE增长0.3%，储蓄率降至2.7%；名义消费增加652亿美元，其中服务贡献582亿美元。

marketWindow.en: Observation window: July 30 release through the US close. Microsoft and Meta earnings dominated AI stock dispersion, so index returns are recorded but not assigned solely to PCE.
marketWindow.zh: 观察窗口：7月30日数据发布至美股收盘。微软与Meta财报主导AI股票分化，因此记录指数表现，但不把它全部归因于PCE。

repricing.en: The monthly cooldown offset part of the prior day's hawkish impulse and long yields held near 4.67%, but 3.3% core inflation and a thin household saving buffer leave any easing path conditional on further confirmation.
repricing.zh: 月度降温抵消了前一日部分鹰派冲击，长端收益率维持在约4.67%；但3.3%的核心通胀与偏薄的家庭储蓄缓冲，使任何宽松路径仍取决于后续确认。

equityReaction.en: The S&P 500 rose 1.7%, the Dow 1.2% and the Nasdaq 2.8%. AP identified Microsoft's AI-profit signal as the main driver, while Meta's higher capex floor pulled its shares down 8%—a clean reminder that earnings quality outweighed the macro print inside this window.
equityReaction.zh: 标普500上涨1.7%、道指上涨1.2%、纳指上涨2.8%。美联社把微软AI投入开始转化为利润视为主要驱动；Meta上调资本开支下限则令其股价下跌8%——说明该窗口内盈利质量的影响强于宏观数据本身。

industryTransmission.en: Cooling inflation supports valuation duration and firm real consumption supports cloud and enterprise demand. But a 2.7% saving rate, services-heavy spending and future energy pass-through keep consumer, wage and data-center margin risks alive.
industryTransmission.zh: 通胀降温支持估值久期，实际消费稳健支持云与企业需求；但2.7%的储蓄率、服务主导的支出结构及未来能源成本传导，仍保留消费、工资与数据中心利润率风险。

verdict.en: A genuine monthly disinflation step, not proof that price stability is restored; the equity rally was earnings-led. Not investment advice.
verdict.zh: 这是一次真实的月度通胀降温，但尚不足以证明价格稳定已经恢复；股市反弹主要由财报驱动。非投资建议。

name.en: FOMC Holds as Three Voters Prefer a Hike
name.zh: FOMC维持利率，三名票委主张加息

before.en: Most economists expected another hold. A minority of one to three hike dissents was plausible because inflation remained elevated, investment was solid and the Middle East energy shock had lifted the inflation tail.
before.zh: 多数经济学家预期继续维持利率。由于通胀仍高、投资稳健且中东能源冲击抬高通胀尾部风险，一至三张加息异议票并非意外。

print.en: The Committee held 3.50–3.75% by a 9–3 vote; three members preferred a 25bp hike.
print.zh: 委员会以9比3维持3.50%–3.75%；三名成员主张加息25个基点。

marketWindow.en: Observation window: July 29 statement through the US close. Oil surged on a fresh Iran shock, so the rates and equity moves below are observed jointly and are not attributed to the Fed alone.
marketWindow.zh: 观察窗口：7月29日声明发布至美股收盘。伊朗局势新冲击同时推高油价，因此下述利率与股市波动是联合观察结果，不能全部归因于美联储。

repricing.en: The 2-year yield fell about 3.7bp while the 10-year rose about 6.7bp to 4.67%: a bearish steepening consistent with long-run inflation and term-premium risk, not a simple near-term hike repricing. July payroll weakness later reduced September hike odds.
repricing.zh: 2年期收益率下降约3.7个基点，10年期上升约6.7个基点至4.67%：这更像长期通胀与期限溢价驱动的熊市陡峭化，而非简单的近期加息重定价。随后7月非农走弱又压低了9月加息概率。

equityReaction.en: At the close, the Dow fell 2.2%, the S&P 500 1.5% and the Nasdaq 1.7%. The hawkish hold and higher long yields pressured duration, but the concurrent oil shock materially contaminated the window.
equityReaction.zh: 收盘时，道指下跌2.2%、标普500下跌1.5%、纳指下跌1.7%。鹰派维持与长端收益率上行压制长久期资产，但同期油价冲击显著污染了事件窗口。

industryTransmission.en: Higher long yields raise the hurdle rate for AI projects with distant cash flows; the split favors already-profitable platforms and bottleneck suppliers over leveraged capacity stories. Energy inflation also raises data-center power and cooling costs.
industryTransmission.zh: 长端收益率上升会提高远期现金流型AI项目的资本门槛；政策分歧更有利于已盈利平台和瓶颈供应商，而非高杠杆扩产叙事。能源通胀还会抬高数据中心电力与散热成本。

verdict.en: Hawkish hold before payrolls: inflation credibility remained the binding constraint. Not investment advice.
verdict.zh: 非农发布前属于鹰派维持：通胀可信度仍是硬约束。非投资建议。

name.en: Ratepayer pledge expands to utilities and states
name.zh: 电力用户保护承诺扩大至公用事业与州政府

before.en: AI data-center demand was colliding with grid capacity, financing needs and public resistance to higher household power bills.
before.zh: AI数据中心需求正与电网容量、融资需求及居民对电费上涨的抵触发生碰撞。

print.en: The White House reported more than 200 additional participants joining the Ratepayer Protection Pledge. Large data-center operators are to fund the generation and infrastructure their projects require.
print.zh: 白宫表示，超过200家新增参与者加入电力用户保护承诺。大型数据中心运营商将承担项目所需发电与基础设施费用。

marketWindow.en: Policy window, not a clean trading event. The July 23 announcement overlapped earnings, power-market news and geopolitical risk; no standalone stock or rate move is assigned.
marketWindow.zh: 这是政策窗口，不是干净的交易事件。7月23日公告与财报、电力市场消息及地缘风险重叠，因此不指定独立股价或利率波动。

repricing.en: Because the pledge is voluntary and implementation sits with utilities, states and contracts, the immediate rate effect is indeterminate. Its economic direction is clearer: data-center capex and project-finance burdens rise while household cost-shifting becomes harder.
repricing.zh: 由于承诺属自愿性质，且落地依赖公用事业、州与具体合同，其即时利率影响无法确定。经济方向更清晰：数据中心资本开支与项目融资负担上升，向居民转嫁成本则更困难。

equityReaction.en: No causal index move is claimed. The policy creates a relative-value split rather than a broad AI beta signal: funded infrastructure bottlenecks gain bargaining power, while marginal developers face a higher all-in cost.
equityReaction.zh: 不主张存在可归因的指数波动。该政策制造的是相对价值分化，而非广泛AI beta信号：资金充足的瓶颈环节议价力上升，边缘开发商的全成本提高。

industryTransmission.en: Power and grid suppliers may see demand, while operators must fund incremental capacity. The White House’s projected consumer benefits are claims to track, not independently verified realized savings.
industryTransmission.zh: 电力与电网供应商可能获得需求，但运营商需为新增容量融资。白宫预期的用户收益是待跟踪的说法，并非已独立核验的实际节省。

verdict.en: Direct industrial-policy support, with higher self-funded capex intensity. Not investment advice.
verdict.zh: 产业政策直接支持，同时要求更高强度的自筹资本开支；执行风险不可忽略。非投资建议。

before.en: The administration framed foreign chip dependence as an economic and national-security vulnerability.
before.zh: 政府把对外国芯片供应的依赖界定为经济与国家安全脆弱点。

print.en: A 25% duty applied to a narrow category including Nvidia H200 and AMD MI325X chips, with exemptions for US data centers, R&D, startups and other domestic buildout; a broader second phase remains possible.
print.zh: 包括Nvidia H200与AMD MI325X在内的一小类先进芯片被征收25%关税，但美国数据中心、研发、初创企业及其他本土建设用途获豁免；更广泛的第二阶段仍有可能。

marketWindow.en: Announcement window: after the January 14 US close. Nvidia, AMD and Qualcomm edged lower after hours, but the action overlapped China export-security rules and Taiwan negotiations; no full-session index attribution is made.
marketWindow.zh: 公告窗口：1月14日美股收盘后。Nvidia、AMD与Qualcomm盘后小幅走低，但该行动与对华出口安全规则及台湾谈判重叠，因此不作完整交易日指数归因。

repricing.en: The exemption design protects current US AI construction rather than imposing a blanket 25% tax on domestic data-center demand. Broader phase-two risk still rewards US manufacturing and packaging commitments and increases supplier and country dispersion.
repricing.zh: 豁免设计保护当前美国AI建设，并非对美国数据中心需求一律征收25%税率。更广泛的第二阶段风险仍奖励美国制造与封装承诺，并扩大供应商与国家分化。

equityReaction.en: The thin after-hours decline was directionally cautious, not evidence of a 25% earnings hit. Company outcomes depend on destination, exemption eligibility, China licensing and whether customers can reroute or absorb costs.
equityReaction.zh: 盘后小幅下跌体现谨慎情绪，并不意味着盈利遭受25%冲击。公司结果取决于目的地、豁免资格、对华许可，以及客户能否改道或吸收成本。

industryTransmission.en: US fabs, advanced packaging and compliant domestic supply chains receive a policy premium. Accelerator vendors preserve US data-center demand but face export-channel and country-negotiation risk; cloud buyers retain leverage through exempt domestic buildout.
industryTransmission.zh: 美国晶圆厂、先进封装与合规本土供应链获得政策溢价。加速器厂商保住美国数据中心需求，却承受出口渠道与国家谈判风险；云买家则通过本土建设豁免保留议价能力。

verdict.en: Direct Trump leverage over AI industry economics is stronger than his direct leverage over a single FOMC vote. Not investment advice.
verdict.zh: 特朗普对AI产业经济性的直接影响，强于其对单次FOMC投票的直接影响；豁免范围比标题税率更重要。非投资建议。
